name: Gem Match-3
tagline: Swap gems, match three in a row.
description: Bejeweled-style match-3 puzzle. 8x8 grid, six gem colors with animated sparkle, swap-to-match logic, cascading drops, combo scoring, and a 60-second timer.
prompt_template: Build a match-3 puzzle game in Unity 2D. 8x8 board of gems in 6 colors. Click and drag two adjacent gems to swap; if a row/column of 3+ same-colored gems forms, they pop and gems above fall down with cascade detection. 60-second timer, score tracker, simple game-over screen.
